cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - BinTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
A Type tray variant to be used up right with sloped walls in front
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BinTray --sx 40:60 --sh 30:50:40 --y 80 --outside 0 --front 0.5 --hole_dD 4 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes BinTray --sx --sh --y --outside --front --hole_dD --thickness --reference --labels
